requirements.statement: Versioned Harness V2 documentation records completed pilot runs, measured latency, corrected retention semantics, and unresolved operational risks without overstating the sample.

criteria.statement: The implementation plan and worklog identify the exact candidate runs, accepted commits, observed latency, corrected retention model, and residual SLO limits.
negative_definitions: Marking an unmeasured P95 or concurrency target as passing does not qualify.
Leaving the pilot status as pending does not qualify.
A local-only Gate result does not qualify.
